sources_note: Names and descriptions are the official PlayStation wording as reported by Exophase and cross-checked against PSNProfiles, PowerPyx, Push Square, Insider Gaming and Planet GTA 6 on 21 November 2026. Source names only, no links. SOURCES DISAGREE: Push Square counts 5 Silver / 47 Bronze while PowerPyx and Insider Gaming count 6 Silver / 46 Bronze; Planet GTA 6 says the missable question cannot be settled yet, while PowerPyx and GTABase flag Positive Mental Attitude as possibly missable.

trophies.guide: The Platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is no extra task of its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: Work through the other 54 trophies in any order; the Platinum unlocks automatically when the last one lands.
Check your overall count in the header bar of this guide — when it reads 54 of 54, the Platinum is next.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing and it unlocks during the campaign.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.text: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end — follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-pass screen appears.
No side content is needed; this one comes from the story alone, so just keep playing the campaign.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Clear every mission in Chapter 1 to close the chapter.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.text: Play through all of Chapter 1's missions in order until the chapter-end card appears.
If a mission fails, replay it from the pause menu — progress is kept and the chapter still closes.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2 in full; the asterisks in the name are part of the official title.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.text: Complete every story mission in Chapter 2, in the order the game presents them.
Side activities are optional here — only the chapter's story missions count toward closing it.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. See Chapter 3 through to its final mission.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.text: Work through Chapter 3's mission chain until the chapter wraps up.
Use the mission replay menu if you want a better medal — it is not required for the trophy.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the last chapter of the campaign's four-chapter structure.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.text: Complete all story missions in Chapter 4.
Stock up on armour and ammo before the chapter's later missions — they are the toughest stretch of the story.

trophies.guide: Gold story trophy. Beat the final mission and the credits roll with this trophy in hand.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Finish the final mission — it unlocks after Chapter 4's last story beat.
After the credits you can keep free-roaming Leonida, so nothing here blocks the cleanup trophies.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the campaign.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.text: Follow the story until the Breakfast Run mission marker appears, then play it through.
Keep a fast car nearby — the mission's driving sections go smoother with one.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Pull off The Cartel Heist mission to earn it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.text: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story and complete it.
Bring heavy weapons and full armour — heist shootouts are long and the checkpoints are sparse.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.text: Play the Child's Play mission when the story offers it.
Follow the mission's prompts closely — the objectives change quickly in this one.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.text: Take on the Headliners mission when it unlocks in the story.
Stay on the move during the set-piece — standing still draws the most fire.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the VCIA Takedown mission at Vice City International Airport.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.text: Play the VCIA Takedown mission to completion.
Learn the airport layout on your first run — the escape route matters more than the firefight.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.text: Complete Operation Savage Glory when the story reaches it.
Pack a rifle with a scope — the mission's long sightlines reward accurate fire.

trophies.guide: Gold. Reach 100% completion — the 35-task checklist that unlocks after the story ends. This is the longest grind in the game, roughly 200 hours to Platinum overall.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Finish the story first: the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks after the final mission, and you can track it via Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion.
Clear the checklist's 35 tasks — story, activities, collectibles and exploration — and the trophy pops at 100%.

trophies.guide: Silver. Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts spread across Leonida — stunt jumps, bridge fly-unders and more. You only need a little over half of them.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Open Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots to see every stunt on the map, and track progress under Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts.
Flying under bridges is reported as the quickest stunt type to repeat — chain them along the coast and rivers.
Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, so skip the awkward ones and bank the easy ones first.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once — a sampler trophy that pushes you to taste everything Leonida offers.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.text: Sample each activity type once: races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, drone races, stunts and challenges.
You only need to try each one, not win or finish it — one attempt per type is enough.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver. Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — every weapon, every drill, at gold standard.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.text: Visit a Shooting Range and work through its challenges weapon by weapon; gold medals are per challenge, not per visit.
Learn each drill's scoring first with a bronze run, then push for gold once you know the target layout.
Use the counter in this guide to tick off each gold medal — 42 in total.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course to beat.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.text: Find a Top Fun drone race kiosk, fly the course and finish first — repeat at each of the 14 locations.
Learn the gates on a practice pass before racing for the win; the tight corners punish blind speed.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count, so keep moving to fresh courses.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.text: Enter races across Leonida — street, off-road and water — and win 20 distinct ones.
Pick the right vehicle class for each race; a mismatched car turns an easy win into a grind.
Track which races you have already won in this guide so you never repeat one by accident.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. One good catch against the right rival is all it takes.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.text: Meet Cal at a fishing spot and accept his challenge.
Out-fish him: land the bigger catch by watching the line tension and reeling in steadily instead of yanking.

trophies.guide: Complete a single arcade game — any cabinet, any game, one full playthrough.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.text: Walk into an arcade, pick any cabinet and play it through to the end screen.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand trophy. Finish Andy's mission chain, ending with his final mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.text: Find Andy's stranger missions around Leonida and work through his chain in order.
His final mission only appears once the earlier ones are done — clear them as they show up.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand trophy. Complete Kenton's chain through to his last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.text: Track down Kenton's missions and finish each one as it unlocks.
Keep a boat-ready vehicle in mind — his missions tend to end near the water.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand trophy. See Billy's mission chain through to its final ride.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.text: Complete Billy's stranger missions in order until his final one appears.
A fast bike helps — his missions are built for two wheels.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret are five of them, so find three more.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.text: Hunt down stranger markers (the ? icons) across the map and finish each person's whole chain.
Five strands belong to named contacts — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — plus Bret's hunt, so you need a few more beyond them.
Some strands only open as the story advances, so revisit stranger spots after each chapter.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand trophy. Finish Randy's mission chain with his final mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.text: Play through Randy's stranger missions in order.
His chain leans on deliveries — keep a sturdy van or truck handy for the cargo runs.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand trophy. Complete Tyrone's chain, ending with his final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.text: Work through Tyrone's stranger missions as they appear.
His final mission is the payoff for the whole chain — finish the earlier ones first.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. WARNING — the only trophy reported as possibly missable: one meditation spot is tied to Chapter 1, so meditate early and check every spot before the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.text: Meditate at every spot: sit at each marked location and complete the meditation prompt.
Do the Chapter 1 spot BEFORE finishing Chapter 1 — PowerPyx and GTABase flag it as the one spot that may not come back.
Sweep the remaining 17 spots in free roam after the story; the counter in this guide tracks all 18.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy. Hunt down a unique animal for Bret — one specific creature, not just any wildlife.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.text: Meet Bret and take his hunting request — he points you at one unique animal.
Track it patiently: approach downwind, stay quiet, and take the shot only when the animal is still.

trophies.guide: Silver. Complete 3 full collectible card sets — find every card in each set, not just a few.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.text: Collect cards wherever they hide — shops, interiors and out-of-the-way spots across Leonida.
A set only counts when every card in it is found, so finish one set completely before chasing the next.
Use the in-game collection screen to see which cards each set is still missing.

trophies.guide: Silver. Use the WAiNK phone app to scan 100 locations — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures are named, with No Flusher tags filling the rest.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.text: Open WAiNK on the phone (hold Up) and scan a landmark, curiosity or sculpture — each successful scan counts.
Named scans total 89 (31 landmarks + 35 curiosities + 23 sculptures), so finish the count with No Flusher tags.
Scan as you travel instead of saving it for the end — the app is always in your pocket.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 challenges — the small feats scattered through activities, combat and exploration.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.text: Open the challenges list and pick the easy ones first — driving, shooting and exploration feats stack up fast.
Challenges complete passively as you play, so check the list often and mop up the near-finished ones.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then escape the heat together.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.text: With your partner alongside, build heat until you hold a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight, leave the search area and stay hidden until the stars clear — both of you must escape.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — keep the heat the whole way.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.text: Plan a route past three close-together shops before you start, so there is no dead time between robberies.
Rob the first shop, then move straight to the next two — if the wanted level drops to zero, the chain resets.
Keep the getaway car parked facing the road at each stop; every second counts.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. GTABase reports that scanning vehicles with WAiNK counts — you do not need to drive them.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.text: Scan vehicles with WAiNK as you pass them — each new model discovered counts, no driving required.
Cruise busy roads and parking lots where traffic is dense; variety matters, not repeats of the same car.
Check your discovered-vehicle count in the progress menu to see how close you are to 100.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus — one slow-motion window, five takedowns.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.text: Trigger Combat Focus only when at least five enemies are in front of you — a gang hideout or a police ambush works.
Aim for quick headshots and switch targets fast; the focus window is short, so do not reload mid-way.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — leave by air, without a ticket or a flight plan.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.text: Get to VCIA, find a plane on the tarmac and get it airborne.
Ignore the runway rules: any takeoff that is not a scheduled flight counts as your unscheduled departure.

trophies.guide: The Rhino is the tank — and the description hints it gets hot inside. Get behind the wheel of one.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.text: Find a Rhino tank — they appear at high wanted levels and around military areas.
Get inside and drive it; surviving the attention it draws is half the fun.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — in and out like a ghost, no alarms, no witnesses.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.text: Case the store first: watch the guards and cameras, then enter when the floor is quiet.
Move slowly, stay out of sight lines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.guide: Silver. Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — five clean getaways, not just five attempts.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.text: Hit a bank vault, grab the cash and break away before the police lock the area down.
Plan the escape before the robbery: a fast car, a route out of the search zone, and no wasted seconds inside.
Repeat at five different vaults — the counter in this guide keeps your tally.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — a classic GTA move, done right.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.text: Find an armored truck on its route and stop it — block the road or disable it.
Crack it open, take the cash and escape before the response arrives.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — every named corner of the state, from Vice City to the swamps.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.text: Drive, fly and sail through every named area; the game marks each one as explored when you pass through it.
Use a plane or helicopter for the far corners — the swamps and keys are slow by road.
Check the exploration map for gaps and sweep the last few areas deliberately.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — every crew in Leonida gets hit once.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.text: Find an illegal operation — a stash house, a lab or a racket — and rob it.
Repeat for each of the 9 gangs; the same gang twice does not count.
Expect armed resistance — these spots are guarded, so go in prepared.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — slow down, sit down, and watch the coast.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.text: Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view of the water.
Order a cocktail and enjoy it — the trophy is about the moment, not a mission.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — straight through the glass, the way it was always meant to be done.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.text: Get inside a vehicle showroom and pick a car with some weight behind it.
Drive straight out through the front glass — no reversing, no sneaking, just the classic exit.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — a full game of bowling, Vice City style.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.text: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and start a game.
Play through the frames — the follow-through is what the trophy is watching for.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — a story moment between the two leads that the game marks as a high point.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.text: Keep playing the story with your partner — this one unlocks from a partnership scene in the campaign.
It is tied to story progress, not to a checklist, so there is nothing extra to grind for it.

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — the game counts the decisions you make across the story and the open world. The tracked count runs to 500.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.text: Make choices whenever the game offers them — dialogue picks, mission approaches and open-world decisions all feed the count.
Keep choosing through the whole playthrough; the count builds across the campaign, so it lands late.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — fail something once, then succeed on the retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.text: Fail an attempt at something — a mission, a challenge or a stunt — then go straight back in.
Succeed on the second try and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — witness something strange in Leonida, the kind of moment you have to see to believe.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.text: Explore the odd corners of the map — remote spots, late-night locations and places that feel out of place.
When something strange happens, stay and watch it through — the trophy triggers on the event itself.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down from a moving vehicle with a melee swing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.text: Get a vehicle moving at a steady speed with a melee weapon ready.
Swing as you pass a pedestrian — a clean melee hit from the moving vehicle is the Ten Pin.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — dirty money in, clean money out.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.text: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists, then take them to a contact who launders them.
Each laundering run takes a cut, so keep bringing bills until the clean total hits $250,000.
Bank robberies and vault hits are the richest source of Marked Bills — pair this with Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, cars, anything with a price tag counts.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.text: Spend freely at any shop — clothing stores, gun shops, car dealers and more all count toward the total.
Big-ticket buys like vehicles and heavy weapons move the counter fastest.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — every lock-up in Leonida, bought and owned.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.text: Find garage properties for sale across the map — they are marked on the in-game property sites.
Buy all 8; save up first, because the later garages are the expensive ones.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — your own little delivery fleet, on the books.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app on the phone and register a vehicle you own or have just found.
Repeat with 10 different vehicles — scooters count, but so does anything else you register.
